name: Starhawk-class Battleship Mark II
description: The Starhawk-class Battleship Mark II was a class of battleship used by the naval arm of the burgeoning New Republic. The Mark II was part of the Starhawk-class line of ships, which included the initial prototype and the Mark I. The Starhawks were built from disassembled Imperial Star Destroyers and had a hatchet shaped frontal hull.
